prompts_findings.prompt_lead: Draw the agent loop as an ASCII diagram. Name the harness, the LLM, the tool-call s

risks_fired.evidence: Four named sub-elements to include in one diagram may draw a brief 'I'll diagram these four parts' opener, but this is a single-output request with no plan-mode and no sequential sub-steps, so preamble risk stays low.
risks_fired.fix_hint: Optional body primer ('Claude may open with a framing sentence — skip to the diagram') if delivery experience shows disruption; low confidence, not blocking.

prompts_findings.prompt_lead: List the tools you have available in this session. One line each.

Explain how you know what tools you can call in this session.

Then explain how MC

risks_fired.evidence: Three sequential moves ('Explain... Then explain... Last, tell me...') may draw a short framing sentence before the first answer, but sits below the 4+-sub-step structural trigger (check_prompts.md §17), and each move is itself an explanation, not an action being narrated-before.
risks_fired.fix_hint: One-line body primer after the fence if preamble disrupts flow in delivery; not blocking.

risks_fired.evidence: 'tell me whether any of them are deferred until you need them' asks Claude to characterize its own opaque tool-loading state, which it cannot literally introspect. Confidence stays low because the clause anchors to a real in-scrollback artifact — Prompt 2's actual returned list — giving Claude concrete evidence to check its claim against rather than a bare self-grade. This is also the sequence's deliberate teaching moment (backing block OODA: 'the incompleteness is the setup, not a defect') — check_pedagogy.md §51 deliberate-antipattern carve-out applies: the gap is what the three-prompt sequence is built to expose, so it is accepted-by-design rather than a defect calling for restructure or a body callout.
risks_fired.fix_hint: Already mitigated by design: the maintainer block's own Watch-for names the accurate trainer-facing answer ('the returned list is a summary, not a manifest... /mcp is the authoritative answer'); no further prompt or body change owed.
